item.title: Reminder: Submissions Portal Closed July 1 - July 31
item.description: Reminder: Submissions Portal Closed July 1 - July 31 Due varying demands required of editors and reviewers, EPAA/EPAA will not process new submissions in English, Spanish, or Portuguese languages during the month of July. During this time the portal will be closed to new submissions. The submissions portal will reopen on August 1, 2022. Authors with manuscripts in review or reviewers and editors with existing assignments will not be affected, as all current submissions will still be available.
